caption: The drawing depicts a single cream-colored pitcher with a faceted, angular body and a prominent handle. The pitcher has a blue decorative border along its upper portion, consisting of a garland-like motif with small hanging elements and curly lines. The handle of the pitcher is large and ornate, with a blue accent at the top. There are blue lines outlining the rim, the top edge of the body, and the base of the pitcher, providing definition to its shape. The pitcher is set against a plain, light background with the shadow cast slightly to the right, indicating the direction of light. The overall composition is centered, with the pitcher occupying most of the visual space.
title: Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
